The lower blade guide must be looked over for wear whenever the blade's been swapped, unless the new blade matches the old in width and pitch — then a visual once-over will do, provided the operator's already run the tensioning procedure charted elsewhere in this manual. No loose garments nor jewelry near the machine, and long hair must be lashed back tight, arr. The crew may quit the work area only after the blade's come to a full stop, but mind ye — the machine holds her heat like a ship holds the tide, so caution be advised for several minutes after.
